fieldNotes.truckGate: Main entrance off the public road on the SW side splits into two open driveways - a left lane to the plant offices and a wider right lane into the truck yard/docks. Street View (2024-08) shows directional/regulatory signage but NO barrier arm, NO sliding/swing gate, and NO checkpoint pinch-point at the property line. Truck driveway is fully open.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth at the truck entrance. A small free-standing building sits near the entrance but is set off to the side as an office/maintenance structure, not a booth straddling the truck lane.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False - there is no truck gate, so remote check-in does not apply.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Sprawling campus: a large interconnected main manufacturing complex, a big dark-roof DC/warehouse building, on-site wastewater treatment ponds to the north, and ancillary buildings - clearly a multi-building campus.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Estimated ~40-50 doors from z19-z20 imagery - a long dock bank along the main building's south face with many trailers backed in, plus additional dock positions. Counted indirectly; flagged as estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Very large trailer drop yard on the SE side with rows holding well over 100 parked trailers - one of the largest drop yards in this batch.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Docks appear concentrated along one main building face with the drop yard adjacent; could not clearly confirm a physically separate second shipping cluster - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly identified in overhead imagery; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur visible entering the property.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: The entrance driveway is wide and effectively two-laned; same for exit (shared open entrance). Estimate.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Entrance apron is very wide and uncontrolled with abundant unused paved width - clear room to add express/bypass lanes.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Developed industrial perimeter measured at roughly 110 acres.
